name: Etherscan API V2 (multichain, chainid parameter)
tier_rationale: Etherscan, an established company with published API terms, a privacy policy and paid plans (A8 trusted). Tiers: Etherscan, OKLink, PublicNode trusted; Blockscout, Ethplorer community.

reliability.justification: Explorer API over its own nodes: balances, transactions and contract creation are chain facts.

etherscan.description: Etherscan API key (one key for every EVM chain of the V2 API via chainid)
etherscan.plan_hint: business = an Etherscan API plan held by the company whose terms allow its use (recorded with `v3lum keys set etherscan --plan business`)

api.title: Etherscan API V2 /v2/api?chainid=1: account balance/txlist, contract getcontractcreation

terms.quote: Per-adapter classes (A1 BR3): Blockscout keyless and PublicNode RPC 'open' (free public APIs, terms recorded, as in P205 and P211); Etherscan, Ethplorer and OKLink 'key-terms' (company keys on recorded plans).

api.notes: Quote: binding council text (P212 cond 5). 'Etherscan's terms page sits behind a Cloudflare challenge (rule 1), so legal records it by another channel' (P212 cond 5): the evidence URL answered 403 to the prep check; legal keeps the terms copy. Research C0476 (verified_needs_key): keyless {'status':'0','message':'NOTOK','result':'Missing/Invalid API Key'} inside HTTP 200 - status '0' is ERROR/RATE_LIMITED/QUOTA (P321 markers here), never empty, except the documented 'No transactions found' family with an empty result. The key travels as apikey= (AR01 redaction). Used by evm_explorers only with key 'etherscan'.
api.licensed_alternative: An Etherscan API plan recorded as key_plans.etherscan='business'; Blockscout (open) and the PublicNode RPC keep keyless coverage.

notes: Owned by batch p2-G09-2 (P212). Free key ~5 calls/s and ~100k calls/day (research C0476; check the plan): quota per key with the 80 % margin, 0.34 s politeness.
